verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers an MCP server for AI tools to query behavioral data conversationally (docs-11/17/34) and a Dashboard REST API to pull chart/graph data as JSON (docs-30), plus a CLI wizard that can generate a first dashboard (docs-27). However, no evidence shows an agent can programmatically create/configure a full dashboard of custom metrics end-to-end via API or MCP—existing APIs appear read-focused (export data) rather than dashboard-authoring.
